title: OP ESP AND AIMBOT WITH WALLCHECK ANTIBAN
features:
🔫 NICKHUB: FLICK / QUICK SHOT | ULTIMATE SCRIPT 

Description: Dominate the arena in FLICK (Quick Shot) with the all-new NickHub Ultimate. Unlike other scripts, NickHub features an exclusive "Deep Scan" Algorithm that detects bots and players even when they are hidden deep inside map folders or models.

This script is fully optimized, secure, and comes with a beautiful, smooth-draggable Dark UI.

🔥 KEY FEATURES

-Deep Scan Technology: Detects targets hidden inside nested folders/models (where normal ESP fails).

-Customizable: Adjust transparency and colors to fit your style.

🎯 COMBAT ASSIST (AIMBOT)

-FOV Circle: Visualize your aim radius.
-Visibility Check: Ensures the aimbot only targets enemies behind cover (Wall Check).
-Target Selection: Head or Body priority.

🛡️ SECURITY & UI

Auto-Game Detection: The script automatically checks if you are in the correct game (FLICK ID: 136801880565837) before executing.

Smooth Draggable UI: A fully remastered GUI that can be moved smoothly across the screen.

Optimization: Zero lag, lightweight code.
